name: Shredded Beef Enchiladas with Mild Ranchero Sauce
whyItWorks: Soft corn tortillas stuffed with slow-braised, tender shredded beef and topped with a mild tomato-based ranchero sauce offer digestible protein without seeds or skins. Light melted cheese adds calories safely if lactose tolerant.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Specify mild ranchero sauce instead of spicy red or green chile sauce. Ask for sour cream on the side.
